Compatibility mode uses a separate browser profile and disables Chromium\'s Linux process sandbox. The browser can still access files inside this app. Avoid untrusted websites and use the Android system browser for important accounts. Reopen Chromium after changing modes.

Standard Linux sandboxing is enabled by default. If Chromium cannot start, you can select compatibility mode. It disables the Linux process sandbox and uses a separate profile, while retaining access to app files. Avoid untrusted websites; use the Android system browser for important accounts.
